product.olivetti-envision-400.summary: The Envision living-room PC in its 486 configuration.
product.olivetti-envision-400.history: Olivetti introduced Envision in 1995 for use with a television in the living room. In December, MCmicrocomputer listed the 420 MB version with an infrared keyboard at 2,990,000 lire before VAT.
product.olivetti-envision-400.architectu: It could use a television and be controlled from the sofa. The onboard Trident video supports a TV and the console receives signals from the infrared keyboard with a trackball.
product.olivetti-envision-400.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-envision-400.limitation: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-envision-400.service-gu: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 15
product.olivetti-envision-400.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 2.06.
